lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters organized into vertical columns. The columns posterior to the gill region show a staggered arrangement, transitioning into a more structured grid pattern towards the mid-section of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity blobs are positioned at the nodes of faint vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity, creating a visible geometric lattice across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct horizontal linear features are present, particularly a prominent ridge running parallel to the midline with a detectable luminance gradient: higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity/shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of smaller, irregularly shaped high-luminance points that contrast with the larger, more uniform blobs found on the primary lateral flank.
